Question Description:
There are N pockets and each pocket contains some bitcoin(s). Your task is to select an integer X and remove all the pockets in which the number of bitcoins is equal to X. Divide the remaining pockets into two non-empty groups such that:

The number of bitcoin(s) in each pocket of the first group is strictly smaller than X.
The number of bitcoin(s) in each pocket of the second group is strictly larger than X.
The total number of bitcoins of one group is equal to the other.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^5
1 <= Ai <= 10^5

Input Format:
The first line contains an integer N denoting the number of pockets.
The second line contains N space-separated integers, denoting the number of bitcoins in N pockets. The i-th integer denotes the values of Ai

Output Format:
Print YES, if it is possible to divide the pockets into two groups, else print NO.
